definitions.gloss: desire for possession; possessiveness; acquisitive desire
definitions.explanation: The desire to own things or to have something exclusively for oneself. Can refer to material possessions, relationships, or abstract things.

examples.japanese: {所有欲|しょゆうよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: To have a strong desire for possession.

examples.japanese: {所有欲|しょゆうよく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たす→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To shop in order to satisfy the desire for possession.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦につれて→につれて：28400_nitsurete⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{所有欲|しょゆうよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}れて→薄れる：14107_usureru⟧きた。
examples.english: As I've gotten older, my desire for possessing things has faded.

notes: Part of the ～⟦{欲|よく}→欲：13183_yoku⟧ (desire for ~) word family, which includes {支配欲|しはいよく} (desire for control), ⟦{独占欲|どくせんよく}→独占欲：15173_dokusenyoku⟧ (desire to monopolize), and {購買欲|こうばいよく} (desire to buy). The word can carry a negative connotation when describing excessive materialism or controlling behavior in relationships. Common collocations: {所有欲|しょゆうよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (to be possessive), {所有欲|しょゆうよく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たす→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧ (to satisfy one's possessiveness).
